mapper.update: WITH due AS ( SELECT a.id FROM user_picture_action a WHERE a.is_processed = 0 AND a.is_accumulated = 0 AND (a.claim_token IS NULL OR a.claim_expire_at IS NULL OR a.claim_expire_at <= statement_timestamp()) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM picture p WHERE p.id = a.picture_id AND p.is_delete = 0) ORDER BY a.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE user_picture_action a SET claim_token = #{claimToken}, claimed_at = statement_timestamp(), claim_expire_at = statement_timestamp() + (#{leaseSeconds} * interval '1 second'), attempt_count = a.attempt_count + 1 FROM due WHERE a.id = due.id
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, picture_id, action_type, action_value, source, event_id, created_time, is_processed, is_accumulated, claim_token, claimed_at, claim_expire_at, attempt_count FROM user_picture_action WHERE claim_token = #{claimToken} AND is_accumulated = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE user_picture_action SET is_accumulated = 1 WHERE claim_token = #{claimToken} AND is_accumulated = 0 AND id IN #{id}
UPDATE user_picture_action SET is_processed = 1, claim_token = NULL, claimed_at = NULL, claim_expire_at = NULL WHERE claim_token = #{claimToken} AND is_accumulated = 1 AND is_processed = 0
UPDATE user_picture_action SET is_processed = 1, claim_token = NULL, claimed_at = NULL, claim_expire_at = NULL WHERE is_processed = 0 AND is_accumulated = 1
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_processed = 0 AND is_accumulated = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)::bigint AS pending_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_processed = 0 AND is_accumulated = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)::bigint AS accumulated_pending_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_processed = 0 AND claim_token IS NOT NULL AND claim_expire_at > statement_timestamp() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)::bigint AS claimed_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_processed = 0 AND attempt_count >= #{stuckThreshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)::bigint AS stuck_count FROM user_picture_action
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_picture_action a LEFT JOIN picture p ON p.id = a.picture_id AND p.is_delete = 0 WHERE a.is_processed = 0 AND a.is_accumulated = 0 AND p.id IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_picture_action WHERE is_processed = 1 AND created_time < #{threshold}
